question: Which individual R266 macro entry gate contributes useful selection or risk control, and which is unnecessarily restrictive?

selection_basis.prior_result: R274 removed all three gates and improved returns while failing drawdown, loss-tail and top-3/top-5 concentration gates
selection_basis.candidate_family: remove exactly one of ERP, credit spread, or term spread; retain the other two at R266 thresholds

only_changed_behavior.erp: Remove ERP >= 5.5; retain credit_spread_5y_low >= -0.8 and term_spread_10y_2y >= 0.3.
only_changed_behavior.credit: Remove credit_spread_5y_low >= -0.8; retain ERP >= 5.5 and term_spread_10y_2y >= 0.3.
only_changed_behavior.term: Remove term_spread_10y_2y >= 0.3; retain ERP >= 5.5 and credit_spread_5y_low >= -0.8.

gates_per_candidate.P1: R266 control evidence and 3x/4x/5x curve/trade cache hashes match finalized evidence.
gates_per_candidate.P2: Live reload succeeds; control and all three research candidates and four stock factors are registered; zero strategy load errors; synthetic truth table proves exactly one predicate was removed per candidate.
gates_per_candidate.G1: 3x full return positive and >=70% of R266 full return.
gates_per_candidate.G4: 3x validation return positive and annualized return >=5%.
gates_per_candidate.G5: 3x prior-close-rebased validation return retains >=70% of R266.
gates_per_candidate.G6: 4x and 5x full returns are both positive.
gates_per_candidate.R2: 3x maximum drawdown no worse than R266 by more than 3 percentage points.
gates_per_candidate.L1: 3x mean losing-trade loss magnitude no more than R266 +1 percentage point.
gates_per_candidate.L2: 3x worst trade return no worse than R266 by more than 5 percentage points.
gates_per_candidate.C5: At least 8 validation-entry symbols have positive P&L.
gates_per_candidate.C7: Largest single-symbol loss <=20% of gross profit.
gates_per_candidate.C8: Validation-period largest symbol net P&L share <=35%.

family_decision_rule: Run all three preregistered variants; do not select, retune or promote any variant unless that variant passes every listed gate. Results are exploratory because the family follows prior outcome-informed research; any apparent winner requires a new untouched prospective/time holdout. Production remains pause_production.
known_limitations: R266/R274 and the historical validation segment have been repeatedly examined; this family is not independent confirmation.
Macro publication timestamps and point-in-time release lags remain unverified.
Historical HS300 membership and macro snapshots may contain revision or timing bias.
Daily OHLC cannot reproduce queue priority; system T+1 tradability and limit constraints remain approximate.
The three candidates form one outcome-informed family; choosing a passing member would require a fresh prospective holdout.
